payload.core_mechanism_summary: Exhaustively tries all cyclic shifts of first sequence and all integer offsets modulo L, checking for equality with second sequence.
payload.rationale: The solution uses nested loops to brute-force all possible shifts and offsets, which is an exhaustive search over permutations (cyclic shifts) and parameter values. No backtracking or advanced pruning is used; it falls under complete search, specifically permutation enumeration for the cyclic arrangements.
